Review basis

checks: Standalone Decision/Supporting reports navigation preserves open decision details and does not rerun or change the assessment.
variants/lowest-cost-shipment.app-case.json: frozen app package and complete native model/case are unchanged after navigation; Direct remains preferred.
variants/earliest-arrival-shipment.app-case.json: frozen app package and complete native model/case are unchanged after navigation; Backup remains preferred.
variants/budget-exercise/expense-limit-5000.app-case.json: frozen app package and complete native model/case are unchanged after navigation; Direct remains preferred.
consolidation/browser-unconfirmed.case.json: frozen app package and complete native model/case are unchanged after navigation; Direct remains preferred.
consolidation/browser-confirmed.case.json: frozen app package and complete native model/case are unchanged after navigation; Consolidated remains preferred.
Workflow input/report groups are independent; Forms/YAML switching retains an unapplied complete-case draft; restoring it leaves the exact run unchanged.
Shared arrangement inspection stays synchronized between Next action and Reports without recording choices, permissions, answers or assessment reviews.
Current native workflow page has no horizontal overflow at390px.
The retained1.0.1 reference also uses independent input/report groups and Forms/YAML in the current renderer. Its full exported run remains unchanged; it is not migrated to1.1.0.
scope: Only Decision Lab native standalone and guided-review navigation is refreshed. Frozen cases/apps and historical workflow releases are preserved. The custom Shipment Reservation Desk and CLI report keep their own unchanged interfaces and code.
